svg.text: Phase 1 execution structure — eight independent starting points
Horizontal position denotes dependency depth, not calendar time. Lane detail follows.
one pinned codec version for two builds; its copy gate is scheduled last
config · socket · event log · radio interface · receive pipeline · app · image
scenario model · encoder client · sender · rate loop · entrypoint · image
message sender · log-chain assertion · its CI lane
Lanes V and P share only the frozen message formats and byte-identical copies of the encoder sources;
they are therefore independent workstreams. Lane D requires both node images.
